verdict: ROAS holds at 3.92, but purchase momentum softened this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered 39 purchases and $6,035.92 in revenue at a 3.92 return on ad spend — efficiency is solid. However, purchase volume fell 22% in the most recent week, and the last three days of the period recorded just 3 purchases combined, signaling a slowdown that needs to be addressed now. A parallel concern: your Google Business Profile went effectively dark for the final two days of the period, cutting off organic foot-traffic and call intent that normally supports the funnel. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to counter declining reach, and the subscription funnel pages are being rebuilt and going live today to close the session-to-purchase gap that has been compressing conversion. October's focus will be restoring top-of-funnel volume and scaling into the next campaign tier once the funnel is confirmed healthy.
